canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Planet Home Lending, Llc denied {value} of its 7,304 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Planet Home Lending, Llc decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Planet Home Lending, Llc will deny any specific future application with 17.8% probability
Planet Home Lending, Llc is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Planet Home Lending, Llc discriminates or violates law
17.8% applies to Planet Home Lending, Llc's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
